title: GPT Image grew from a model into an editing workflow
summary:
Image generation grew into editing, while MCP authentication, text responses, and community tools got more capable.

`gptimage` joined the image model list with JPEG output and a 1024-pixel maximum side length. It then gained editing when an image is supplied, plus low, medium, high, and hd quality settings. Follow-up changes made string editing inputs work as fetched URLs and made Azure errors easier to diagnose.

MCP authentication moved from session polling to OAuth 2.1, with authorization-code exchange, refresh tokens, and dynamic client registration. The package’s `npx` entry was also corrected so its ES-module CLI starts the server directly.

DeepSeek v3 can return reasoning content when its usual answer field is empty. OpenAI-compatible streams now format each SSE delta, including DeepSeek reasoning in `<think>` tags when an answer follows. Image authorization and generation errors became explicit rather than silently falling back, and the text server’s in-memory response cache was removed.

Azure-hosted Grok-3 Mini joined as `grok` with tool support, and `openai-large` changed from GPT-4.1 Mini to GPT-4.1. WebSim’s HTML generator also gained a `model` query parameter and now favors single-file pages.
